headline: Heavy Fighting Drives Base Changes Across Fronts
war_summary: Since the last edition three hours ago the heaviest sectors have shifted. Weathered Expanse recorded three ownership changes in the past two hours as casualties accelerate to roughly 15 Colonial and 34 Warden per hour. Godcrofts also saw three rapid flips in the same window. Mooring County added two captures while Colonial and Warden losses surged past 200 and 100 per hour respectively. Nevish Line remains the bloodiest front, logging eight base transitions in six hours with Warden casualty rates climbing to 266 per hour, though Colonial rates have eased. Marban Hollow and Kuura Strand have gone quiet in the last two hours after earlier turnover. Linn Mercy and Stlican Shelf each saw a handful of changes over six hours but none recently. Farranac Coast activity has tapered. Callahans Passage and Dead Lands continue to bleed heavily without base movement. Enlistment spikes persist in the most contested zones, suggesting the current flare‑ups may sustain through the next day.
